insert into bangumi_data_item (item_key, bangumi_id, title, item_type, lang, official_site, begin_date, end_date, raw_data, sync_version) values
(#{item.itemKey}, #{item.bangumiId}, #{item.title}, #{item.type}, #{item.lang}, #{item.officialSite}, #{item.begin}, #{item.end}, cast(#{item.rawData} as json), #{item.syncVersion}) as new on duplicate key update bangumi_id = new.bangumi_id, title = new.title, item_type = new.item_type, lang = new.lang, official_site = new.official_site, begin_date = new.begin_date, end_date = new.end_date, raw_data = new.raw_data, sync_version = new.sync_version

insert into bangumi_data_site_meta (site_key, title, site_type, url_template, regions, sync_version) values
(#{site.siteKey}, #{site.title}, #{site.type}, #{site.urlTemplate}, cast(#{site.regions} as json), #{site.syncVersion}) as new on duplicate key update title = new.title, site_type = new.site_type, url_template = new.url_template, regions = new.regions, sync_version = new.sync_version
